screen_selection: every paired validation trace feasible, minimize mean p95; otherwise minimum worst violation, then mean violation, then p95, then lambda
confirmation_scenarios: all 3 topologies x all 3 targets at train load .6; no performance-based filtering
shift_protocol: same architecture and trained target, evaluate all four loads; no retraining at shifted loads
fixed_latency_reuse: training target is unused for fixed/latency rewards; identical checkpoint reused across budget thresholds
ablation_pretraining: retrain from random seed, same 2M latency pretraining and 2M adaptive fine_tuning; include freshly retrained full-state control
scientific_branch_rule: Descriptive rule locked after matched_training inspection, before topology confirmation: all paired rows feasible; >1% mean P95 gain over feasible RL and heuristic comparators; adaptive mean violation no worse than feasible RL comparator. Not a significance test.
reward_sensitivity: unclipped latency cost; all three compute-matched methods, five seeds, same pretraining

holdout: BLOCKED independent provenance; d11 historical, d12-d14 unverified
